notes: Fabricated ability name killed: 'Spirit Fire' (three places) is not an Aurora ability — her W is Across the Veil. The 'Explosion passive burst' framing was also wrong: Spirit Abjuration is a heal (exorcised spirits follow and heal her); rewritten wherever it appeared, and the missing-interaction (her P sustain making losing trades compound) surfaced in dontsFull[2].d and whys[4]. Content win[] matched the packet, so full sides were moved alone with whys rewritten. Whether Between Worlds' shockwave/zone counts as displacement that pool avoids is not in Riot's text — spikes[1] keeps the 'partial escape' wording without asserting mechanics. sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, ahead remain owner-generic templates.
